paite: "Ephesa saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Akhut taklam a aksi sagih tawi dangka-eng khawnvak koihna sagih lai a vialvakpa'n hiai thilte agen hi.
heading: Ephesa Saptuamte Kiang A Laikhak
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: “He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lampstands says these things:

paite: "Na thilhihte, na sepgimdan leh na kuhkaldan, migiloute na ngaihmohdan leh hiloupi a amau sawltak kichite na ze-et a, amaute zuauthei ahi uh chih na muhkhiakdan ka thei hi.
english: “I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.

paite: Huan thuakzohna na nei a, ka min ziak in na thuak teitei a, huchi in leng na bah kei hi.
english: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have TR adds “have labored and” not grown weary.

paite: Himahleh na hon itna masapen na tawpsan thu ah ka hon dem hi.
english: But I have this against you, that you left your first love.

paite: Huaiziak in na pukna laitak theigige inla, kisik in, na thilhih masapente hih nawn in; huchi lou in zaw na kiang ah ka hong pai dia, na kisik keileh a-omna a kipan in na khawnvak koihna ka suan ding hi.
english: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly, and will move your lampstand out of its place, unless you repent.

paite: Himahleh hiai thu ah na hoih, Nikol pawlte thilhihte na hua a, ke'n leng huaite ka hua hi.
english: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

paite: "Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen. Avualzoupa kiang ah Pathian Paradis a om, anek ding in hinna sing ka pe ding achi," chi in.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.

paite: "Huan Smarna a saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Amasapen leh ananungpen, huai si a hing nawnta in hiai thilte agen hi.
heading: Smarna Saptuamte Kiang A Laikhak
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these things:

paite: "Na thilhihte, na gimthuakdan leh na zawndan, himahleh na hau hi, Judate hilou napi, ahi a kigen Setan sinagogte Pathian gensiatna ka thei hi.
english: “I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

paite: Na thuak pah ding thilte kihta ke'n; ngai in, ze-et a na omtheihna ding un diabol in na lak ua akhente suangkul ah ahon khum pah ding; ni sawm sung gimthuakna na nei ding uhi. Sihpha in ginom in om in, huchi in hinna lallukhu ka hon pe ding hi.
english: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.

paite: "Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen. Avualzoupa sih nihna hihnat in a-om kei ding achi," chi in.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.

paite: "Huan Pergamom a saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Namsau hiamtak hiamtuah nei in hiai thilte agen hi.
heading: Pergamos Saptuamte Kiang A Laikhak
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Pergamum write: “He who has the sharp two-edged sword says these things:

paite: "Na tenna leh Setan laltutphah omna leng ka thei; ka min kiptak in na lenden a, Setan tenna mun a ka palai ginom, Antipas thah a a-om lai in leng na ginna na tawpsan tuan kei hi.
english: “I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

paite: Himahleh demna zek ka hon nei, huai lai a mi khenkhat Balaam sinsakna zuite na ompih ziak in, Israel suante ma a kipukna koih ding leh milimte kiang a kithoihna thilte ne ding leh kingaihna khelhna hih ding in ama'n tuh Balak athuhilh hi.
english: But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.

paite: Huchibang mah in Nikol pawlte sinsakna zui, mi khenkhat mah na ompih hi.
english: So you also have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans likewise TR reads “which I hate” instead of “likewise” .

paite: Huaiziak in kisik in; huchi lou in zaw na kiang ah ka hong pai pah dia, amau ka kam a namsau in ka dou ding hi.
english: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly, and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

paite: "Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen. Avualzoupa kiang ah manna selguk ka pe ding, huan suangpek ka pe dia, huai suang tung ah min thak, aneipa lou ngal kuamah in atheih louh a kigelh achi," chi in.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, Manna is supernatural food, named after the Hebrew for “What is it?”. See Exodus 11:7-9. and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written, which no one knows but he who receives it.

paite: "Huan Thiatira a saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Pathian Tapa, meikuang bang mit nei a, sumsan nawttet bang khe neipa'n, hiai thilte agen hi.
heading: Thiatira Saptuamte Kiang A Laikhak
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:

paite: Na thilhihte leh na itna leh na ginna leh na nasepna leh na thuakzohna ka thei hi, amasapen sang in na thilhih nanungte atamzaw hi.
english: “I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.

paite: Himahleh hiai thu ah demna ka hon nei hi, huai numei Jezebel, zawlnei kichinu khawk na sak louh ziak in; ama'n ka sikhate kingaihna khelhna hih ding leh milimte kiang a kithoihna thilte ne ding a khem in ahilh hi.
english: But I have this against you, that you tolerate your TR, NU read “that” instead of “your” woman, Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She teaches and seduces my servants to commit sexual immorality, and to eat things sacrificed to idols.

paite: Huchi in amah akisikna ding in hun ka pia hi; huan amingaihna khelhna ah akisik tuan kei hi.
english: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.

paite: Ngai in, amah damlou lupna ah ka pai ding a, athilhihte akisik tuan keileh amah angkawm teng leng gimthuakna thupi ah ka pai ding hi.
english: Behold, I will throw her into a bed, and those who commit adultery with her into great oppression, unless they repent of her works.

paite: Huan hipi in atate ka that dia; saptuamte tengteng in lungsim kiheinate leh lungtang theipa kei ka hi chih athei ding uh; na thilhihte bangbang un na lak ua mi tengteng ka pe ding hi.
english: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.

paite: "Himahleh, nou, Thiatira a om midangte hiai thuhilh nei lou a, 'Setan thil thukte' thei lou tengteng kiang ah tunggikna dang na tung uah ka hon behlap kei ding, ka chi hi.
english: But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira, as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan,’ to you I say, I am not putting any other burden on you.

paite: Himahleh ka hong mateng na neih pen uh lenkip un.
english: Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.

paite: Huan avualzoupa leh atawp pha a ka nnate kempa kiang ah, namte tung a thuneihna ka pe ding hi;
english: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.

paite: ama'n sikchiang in amau tung ah vai ahawm ding a, leibel bang in amaute akhentam ding hi, hiai thuneihna ka Pa a pan ka muh ahi.
english: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots; Psalm 2:9 as I also have received of my Father:

paite: Huan amah zingsol aksi ka pe ding hi.
english: and I will give him the morning star.

paite: Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen achi," chi in.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
